test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

13, 29, 62, 129, 264, ?
solution:
**The pattern followed here is : **

 
• **(Each number is multiplied by 2) + Number series**
 
• **Number series - 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 is added in this serial order.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b09299d74eb51864d726dbde8155643c72b5f2a44473a54a2a103e4ac849894.png] 

Hence, **"535"** is the correct answer.
